Question 11
?

The length of a curve y=f(x) is given by ∫−1/21/21+11−x2dx. Which of the following could be an equation for this curve?

a
y=2+1−x2
b
y=2+11−x2
c
y=arcsin⁡(1−x2)
d
y=2−arcsin⁡x
e
y=arcsin⁡(x+1)
